title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-08-01
lineage: AudMR > C > C > C > CD;AudMR > R > DAT > WAV > SHN
taper: Unknown & Jeffrey Siniawsky, Neil Merin, and Joel Smith

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a stellar 1973 show featuring a smoking Dark Star > El Paso > Eyes > Morning Dew sequence.
ai_review.review: The concert is hailed as one of the great Dark Star performances, with a space‑y, sweet jam that flows smoothly into El Paso and then into long, memorable Eyes and Morning Dew.  Despite being an outdoor stadium audience tape from ’73, listeners note surprisingly clear, front‑heavy sound that captures the band at the top of their game.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average 4.2) and enthusiastic comments about both musical performance and surprisingly good audience sound quality drive a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Surprisingly clear for a stadium AUD tape; crisp mids, front‑heavy mix that highlights Keith's keyboards and Jerry’s guitar. No major dropouts or muffiness reported.

standout_songs: Dark Star > El Paso > Eyes > Morning Dew
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions, especially the seamless jam from Dark Star into El Paso; the set maintains a relaxed yet high‑energy vibe throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for being on top of his game and delivering hot guitar work, especially during the Dark Star/El Paso jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is described as ‘on fire’, front‑center in the mix, delivering a mighty fine combo.
